{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check the rows with missing flipper_length_mm
missing_flipper = penguins[penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()]
print('Rows with missing flipper_length_mm:')
print(missing_flipper[['species', 'island', 'sex']])

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm
mean_flipper_by_species = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm']).groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort to find the highest
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species.idxmax()
mean_value = mean_flipper_by_species.max()

print('\nMean flipper length by species:')
print(mean_flipper_by_species)
print(f'\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length: {highest_mean_species} ({mean_value:.2f} mm)')}}
